facts.fact: 盐井岛不会被记住；大多数故事都是如此
facts.anchor: Saltwell Island would not be remembered. Most stories never are.

facts.fact: 但寓言不必被记住，也可以是真的
facts.anchor: But a fable doesn’t need to be remembered to be true.

facts.fact: 结局并不像我们以为的那样
facts.anchor: And endings are not what we think they are.

facts.fact: 海比我们能丈量的更深；人的心是想象之地
facts.anchor: The sea is deeper than we can measure; our minds are a place of make-believe.

facts.fact: 站在万物的边缘、望向无名的陆地与海岸时，你可能必须选择：这一种生活，还是等着你的那一种
facts.anchor: you may have to choose: this life, or the one waiting for you.

facts.fact: 结尾三句独立成段：Out there. / Somewhere.
